description: Validated results from the first public evaluation round of ChainMath Benchmark.
scoring_notes: A -10% penalty applies if the model failed to produce valid JSON on the first attempt.
An order-compliance penalty (up to -15%) applies for answers not sorted by ID.

models.notes: Model frequently confused chained references between questions. Failed to produce valid JSON on first attempt. Strong on isolated arithmetic but collapsed under multi-step dependency chains.
Solid performance with extended reasoning enabled. Perfect JSON compliance and ordering. Struggled most with difficulty ★★★★★ questions involving cross-language anaphora.
Best overall result in this cohort. Excellent handling of conditional and comparison questions. Reasoning mode clearly improved performance on high-difficulty chains.
Significant order violation penalty. Model appeared to answer questions independently rather than tracking the running chain. JSON format issues on first try added further penalty.
Competent performance with extended reasoning. Weakness in cross-language difficulty ★★★★ questions. Handled conversion and fraction chains well.

summary.key_observation: Models with extended reasoning / thinking mode consistently outperformed those without. JSON format discipline and chain-tracking are strong differentiators in this benchmark.
